method.base_penalty: intercept 0, all other base columns 1 (as in RoundScreener)
method.design: X = [intercept, standardised current word counts + 8 graph scalars]; candidate column = raw greedy-application count; y = standardised Fit labels
method.direct_reference: solve (Z^T Z + lambda diag([0,1,...,1,1])) a = Z^T y for Z = [X, c] separately per candidate and fold
method.strict_denominator: c_tr^T resid_tr + lambda (Frisch-Waugh for the augmented ridge)

denominator_gap.note: gap = c_tr^T resid_tr - resid_tr^T resid_tr = lambda * ||S||_P^2 >= 0; strict denominator = old denominator + gap
